title: Effect of Surface Wettability on Nanoparticle Deposition during Pool Boiling on Laser-Textured Copper Surfaces
reason: The authors report their own measured pool boiling curves, CHF and HTC values (e.g., "CHF values of 1209 kW m-2 and 1462 kW m-2 were recorded") on laser-textured copper surfaces with TiO2-water nanofluids.
